description: This file contains automated functional tests for the checkout process in an e-commerce web application. It uses xUnit for testing, interacts with web pages via HttpClient, and verifies the flow from adding an item to the cart to completing a checkout and payment.

classes.name: CheckoutTest
classes.description: A test class that contains a test method for verifying successful checkout and payment workflow.

methods.name: SucessfullyPay
methods.description: Performs a sequence of actions to simulate a user adding items to the cart, logging in, and completing a checkout, asserting success at each step.
